documentation.title: Error Severity
documentation.standard:
Never call exit(), die() or wp_die() inside a command: they skip WP-CLI's shutdown and error reporting, and break WP_CLI::runcommand(). Use WP_CLI::error() for fatal failures and WP_CLI::halt( $code ) to set an exit code. exit at file scope, such as the ABSPATH direct-access guard, is not reported.
Requirement: D1 (MUST, error). Error codes: DirectExit (exit, die), WpDieInCli (wp_die()).
